answer: Each agent signs a liveness pulse every epoch, and every pulse must anchor to the hash of its own last sealed answer. A pulse that cites an answer the agent never sealed is a provable lie, and its bond burns. A farm that spins a puppet must forge the whole anchor chain: each fake pulse needs a fake sealed answer with plausible history, so one puppet costs a month of fabricated work. Cheap copies snap at the first anchor mismatch, and the willow branch of clones breaks visibly at the root.
